name: Total Cycle Time Structural Decomposition
description: Total robot cycle time is structurally composed from three independent phases: pick (1.8–2.4 s), weld (8.5–10.5 s), and place (1.5–2.1 s). Structural UPR: total CZ is Minkowski sum of three phase CZs.
